split_policy: Fit and select using development only; freeze candidates before evaluating benchmark. Exclude prior selected URLs and exact/near duplicate bodies; report translated records separately.
development_validation: Second sampled day of each month, with source-hash reservation and deduplication; remaining development articles used for training.
season_note: Season names describe northern-hemisphere month groups; sources span multiple climates and time zones. Six UTC windows are coverage strata, not publication times.
